Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

specs/011-settings-dashboard/data-model.md:21:- `List<int> tenBars({DateTime? today})` → `research.md R2`'s `tenBars` function, `today` defaulting to
specs/011-settings-dashboard/data-model.md:100:| `narrativeStatus` | `NarrativeStatus` enum: `notRequested, loading, loaded, unavailable` | `notRequested` | `notRequested` for the zero/one-entry cases (FR-003/004); never transitions once there (FR-006's distinctness). |
specs/011-settings-dashboard/spec.md:91:- **FR-003**: When the aggregate for the active period contains zero entries, the dashboard MUST show the light-gray placeholder chart icon and "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui", and MUST NOT request or show the narrative.
specs/011-settings-dashboard/spec.md:92:- **FR-004**: When the aggregate contains exactly one entry, the dashboard MUST show a single small bar and "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias.", and MUST NOT request or show the narrative.
specs/011-settings-dashboard/spec.md:93:- **FR-005**: When the aggregate contains two or more entries, the dashboard MUST render the multi-bar chart using whatever of the chart's ten bars the aggregate's buckets populate — naturally partial for a small count, fully populated once an account has enough history (the "more than thirty entries" scenario is the seed count chosen to reliably exercise a fully-populated chart, not a distinct functional threshold) — and MUST request the narrative, showing it once it resolves.
specs/011-settings-dashboard/spec.md:117:- **Dashboard Narrative**: An independently-fetched, AI-generated paragraph describing the aggregate's pattern for the same period. Can succeed, fail, or be skipped (zero/one-entry scenarios) independently of whether the aggregate itself loaded successfully.
specs/011-settings-dashboard/spec.md:141:- **Multi-bar chart applies to any count above one, not only "more than thirty"**: FR-005's chart-and-narrative state is not gated on a literal minimum entry count beyond "two or more" — an account with, say, 5 or 15 entries gets the same multi-bar chart (naturally sparser) and narrative request as a 30+ entry account. The "more than thirty entries" acceptance scenario exists only to guarantee a chart where every one of the ten bars is populated, for a clean, unambiguous test case — not because counts between two and thirty are a separate, unspecified state.

9	/// 52px (`DesignTokens.sizeAvatarSettings`) initials avatar, the current
10	/// `displayName` with an inline pencil-to-check control, and the read-only
11	/// `email` text with no edit affordance beside it (FR-009).
12	class ProfileHeader extends StatefulWidget {
13	  const ProfileHeader({super.key});
14	
15	  @override
16	  State<ProfileHeader> createState() => _ProfileHeaderState();
17	}
18	
19	class _ProfileHeaderState extends State<ProfileHeader> {
20	  final _controller = TextEditingController();
21	  bool _wasEditing = false;
22	
23	  @override
24	  void dispose() {
25	    _controller.dispose();
26	    super.dispose();
27	  }
28	
29	  @override
30	  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
31	    return BlocBuilder<SettingsBloc, SettingsState>(
32	      builder: (context, state) {
33	        final isEditing =
34	            state.nameEditStatus == NameEditStatus.editing ||
35	            state.nameEditStatus == NameEditStatus.saving;
36	        // Seed the controller's text only on the transition into editing —
37	        // never on every rebuild, which would otherwise clobber the
38	        // cursor/selection on each keystroke.
39	        if (isEditing && !_wasEditing) {
40	          _controller
41	            ..text = state.nameDraft
42	            ..selection = TextSelection.collapsed(offset: state.nameDraft.length);
43	        }
44	        _wasEditing = isEditing;
45	
46	        final profile = AccountProfile(displayName: state.displayName, email: state.email);
47	
48	        final emailText = Text(
49	          state.email,
50	          style: DesignTokens.textBodyMd.copyWith(color: DesignTokens.colorTextSecondary),
51	        );
52	
53	        return Padding(
54	          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
55	          child: Column(
56	            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
57	            children: [
58	              Row(
59	                // Default (center) cross-axis alignment is load-bearing here:
60	                // name+email are one column next to the avatar, so the
61	                // avatar centers against their combined height, not just
62	                // the name's — matching the prototype's single `align-items:
63	                // center` row (name/e-mail never sit in a block of their own
64	                // below it).
65	                children: [
66	                  CircleAvatar(
67	                    radius: DesignTokens.sizeAvatarSettings / 2,
68	                    backgroundColor: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,
69	                    child: Text(
70	                      profile.initials,
71	                      style: DesignTokens.textTitleLg.copyWith(
72	                        color: DesignTokens.colorOnPrimary,
73	                      ),
74	                    ),
75	                  ),
76	                  const SizedBox(width: DesignTokens.spacingMd),
77	                  Expanded(
78	                    child: Column(
79	                      mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
80	                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
81	                      children: [
82	                        isEditing
83	                            ? TextField(
84	                                autofocus: true,
85	                                controller: _controller,
86	                                enabled: state.nameEditStatus == NameEditStatus.editing,
87	                                onChanged: (value) => context
88	                                    .read<SettingsBloc>()
89	                                    .add(NameDraftChanged(value)),
90	                                decoration: const InputDecoration(isDense: true),
91	                              )
92	                            : Text(
93	                                state.displayName,
94	                                style: DesignTokens.textTitleSm,
95	                                maxLines: 1,
96	                                overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
97	                              ),
98	                        const SizedBox(height: DesignTokens.spacingXs),
99	                        emailText,
100	                      ],
101	                    ),
102	                  ),
103	                  IconButton(
104	                    icon: Icon(isEditing ? Icons.check : Icons.edit_outlined, size: 20),
105	                    onPressed: state.nameEditStatus == NameEditStatus.saving
106	                        ? null
107	                        : () => context.read<SettingsBloc>().add(
108	                            isEditing ? const NameEditSubmitted() : const NameEditStarted(),
109	                          ),

Understood — I'll rely on the prototype source (the "input package") as ground truth, which is what I already did for every value in this fix. No live device run needed.

## Summary

Fixed all 7 visual discrepancies by transcribing exact values from `docs/input/prototype/cerne-prototype.html`'s "Tela 6 — Configurações" markup (not the summarized `prototype-extract.md`, which doesn't carry pixel-level detail):

1. **"Sua evolução" title** — added above the dashboard card ([settings_page.dart:131](lib/features/settings/presentation/pages/settings_page.dart#L131)), `textHeadlineMd` (Fraunces 600/24), matching the prototype's title style exactly.
2. **Card chrome** — all `DashboardCard` states (loading/failure/empty/single/multi) now render inside a shared rounded card (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1` shadow — these three tokens are an exact match to the prototype's `#FBF9F4`/`16px`/`0 1px 3px rgba(36,31,25,.08)`), replacing the loose bare-Divider layout.
3. **Zero-entries icon** — swapped `Icons.bar_chart` (60px) for `Icons.trending_up` at 28px in `colorChartPlaceholder`, matching the prototype's small `ph-chart-line-up` glyph exactly in size and color.
4. **One-entry bar** — stopped reusing the generic 10-slot chart (which positioned the lone bar at its chronological slot — explaining why it looked pushed right — and scaled its height to its own max, always 100%). It's now a dedicated full-width bar with only the top corners rounded and a fixed short height, per FR-004's "a single small bar."
5. **Header** — replaced the Material `AppBar` with a custom header mirroring Meus Registros': back arrow + left-aligned `textHeadlineMd` serif title on the light background.
6. **Profile row** — name and e-mail are now one `Column` next to the avatar inside a single `Row`, so the avatar centers against their combined height (previously e-mail was a separate block below, pushing it far from the name); pencil switched to `Icons.edit_outlined`.
7. **Sair / Apagar conta** — dropped their icons, now plain tappable text; restored the `colorBorder` top divider above them that was missing.

All changes pass `flutter analyze` clean and the full test suite (662 tests, no regressions).

Where: the export sheet opened from the download icon in Meus Registros with "Todo o período", on an account with no entries. Error: none, visual and text differences only
